title: Joint extraction of DNA and RNA from plankton filters using the commercial DNAbsolute kit
author: Julie Poulain
materials: Briefly centrifuge, ramp up and down, 1000g.

steps.title: Prepare Lysis Buffer
steps.instruction: Preheat one 3600 µL aliquot of Lysis buffer 1 in a 50 mL Falcon tube for 5 min at 56°C.

steps.title: Sample Lysis and Homogenization
steps.instruction: Recover the frozen filter with forceps, cut it with a scalpel into the 50 mL tube with preheated LB1, and add reagents for lysis.

substeps.instruction: Add 360 µL DTT (0.1 M) (1/10 Vol, 10 mM final) to inhibit RNases
Pour in the entire contents of one bashing bead tube
Vortex for 15 sec
Add 360 µL of Proteinase K and mix gently
Incubate at 56°C and 300 rpm

steps.title: Separate Lysate for RNA and DNA
steps.instruction: Collect the lysate at two different time points to separate the RNA and DNA fractions.

substeps.instruction: After 15 min, collect and transfer 400 µL of the solution into a 1.5 mL RNase-free tube for RNA purification
After 60 min, collect the remaining volume (~3200 µL) using a wide-bore tip, transfer it into a 50 mL tube for DNA purification

steps.title: Purify RNA
steps.instruction: Isolate RNA from the 400 µL lysate aliquot.

substeps.instruction: Mark the tube to identify the future pellet location
Centrifuge for 3 min at 10000g
Transfer the supernatant into a new 1.5 mL RNase-free tube
Add 1 volume of Lysis buffer 2 (400 µL) and vortex for 1 sec
Add 1 volume of cold isopropanol (400 µL)
Add 1/10 volume of sodium acetate (40 µL)
Mix gently and incubate for 5 min at 4°C
Centrifuge at 12000g for 15 min
Carefully remove the supernatant without disturbing the RNA pellet
Add 500 µL of 70% ethanol and centrifuge for 5 min at 10000g
Repeat the 70% ethanol wash a second time
Carefully remove the supernatant
Briefly dry the pellet at room temperature (5-10 min)
Resuspend the RNA pellet in 50 µL of RNase-free water
Perform DNase treatment (e.g., Turbo DNase followed by purification) and store at -80°C

steps.title: Purify DNA
steps.instruction: Isolate DNA from the remaining ~3200 µL lysate.

substeps.instruction: Mark the 50 mL tube to identify the future pellet location
Centrifuge for 3 min at 10000g
Transfer the supernatant (~3000 µL) into a new 50 mL tube using a wide-bore tip (1000 µL)
Add 1/100 of the volume (30 µL) of RNase A diluted 1/10 and homogenize by pipetting with a wide-bore tip
Incubate for 2 min at RT
Add 1 volume of Lysis buffer 2 (3000 µL) and homogenize
Add 1 volume of 100% ethanol (3000 µL) and homogenize
Add 1/2 volume of DNAbsolute reagent (1500 µL) and homogenize
Mark the tube to identify the future pellet location
Centrifuge for 5 min at 10000g (Accel: 8, Decel 7; alternative: 16 min at 3000g)
Discard the supernatant by pipetting
Add 200 µL of PBS buffer to the pellet and resuspend by pipetting using 200 µL wide-bore tips
Transfer into a 1.5 mL DNA LoBind tube
Add 1200 µL of 100% ethanol and homogenize using a wide-bore tip
Centrifuge for 5 min at 10000g
Perform 2 washes: add 600 µL of 70% ethanol, centrifuge for 1 min at 10000g at RT, and remove supernatant
Dry the pellet for ~10 min at 37°C
Resuspend with 100 µL of Tris Buffer previously warmed to 37°C
Quantify using Qubit 1X HS DNA and store at -20°C
